# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This repository contains an autoscript to help Spider-Man buy new web cartridges.

## General Guidelines
- Keep scripts simple, readable, and well-commented.
- Follow existing code style and conventions in the repository.
- Prefer clear variable names and straightforward logic over clever one-liners.
- Use MIT license header where applicable.

## Development

- No build step required; scripts run directly.
- Validate inputs before processing them.

## Testing
- Validate any script changes manually before committing.
- Ensure scripts do not produce unintended side effects.

## Contributions
- Write descriptive commit messages that explain the *why* behind changes.
- Keep pull requests focused on a single concern.
